escenas.prompt: Static shot at the back porch in warm afternoon sunlight. The fluffy long-haired orange tabby cat sits in front of the closed white pet door, seen from behind. He waits patiently: his ears twitch, he turns his head slightly toward the pet door, and his fluffy tail sways slowly on the floor. The pet door stays closed. Leaves in the garden move gently in the breeze. Realistic cat movement and size. Static camera. Nobody else. No people. No camera movement.

Static camera. Bright hospital corridor in afternoon light. The nurse in navy scrubs, seen three-quarters from behind, stands still holding her phone; she looks down at it, smiles softly and taps the screen once with her thumb, then lowers the phone a little, relaxed. The phone screen is never visible. Nobody else around. No camera movement.
